classification: SCRIPTED THREE-ARM PAIRED CONFIRMATORY OUTCOME EXPERIMENT. PPO OFF. GPU OFF. CPU ONLY.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-19: freeze n = 128 paired seeds for the fresh confirmatory run with no further tuning; pre-register the terminal interpretation now; no second guard length, no alternate minimum-window fraction, no threshold adjustment after the result.
RESEARCH_QUESTION: Does forbidding composition switching until the selector holds a full evidence window remove the Pole-A harm of the routed controller while keeping a positive Pole-B gain, on fresh seeds?

THE_CONCEPTUAL_CLAIM_UNDER_TEST.mechanism: invalid cold-start evidence -> unsafe early switch
THE_CONCEPTUAL_CLAIM_UNDER_TEST.repair: do not permit composition switching until the statistic is actually valid
THE_CONCEPTUAL_CLAIM_UNDER_TEST.regime_blindness: The guard's only input is the number of samples in the selector's trailing buffer, a function of the tick index alone. It cannot read D_t, the pole, the genome, the opponent or any outcome, and it applies identically on both poles.

PRIOR_EVIDENCE_AND_ITS_STATUS.unguarded_outcome: ROUTED_COMPOSITION_OUTCOME_RESULT.json -- B_GAIN_WITH_EXCESS_A_HARM on an AUDIT_FAILED record (the failure was a seed-registry self-overlap defect, since fixed; see ROUTED_COMPOSITION_OUTCOME_AUDIT_CORRECTION.json). B gain +0.6719 [+0.5156, +0.8125]; A harm +0.1719 [+0.0469, +0.2969] against tau 0.10.
PRIOR_EVIDENCE_AND_ITS_STATUS.localization: ROUTED_COMPOSITION_A_HARM_LOCALIZATION.json -- 82% of the A harm sits in the 27 episodes whose first trigger fires at tick 0; exposure measures did not separate harmful episodes.
PRIOR_EVIDENCE_AND_ITS_STATUS.feature_regime_freeness: ROUTED_COMPOSITION_SWITCH_SAFETY_CONTRAST.json -- D_0 is bit-identical across poles on 64 of 64 paired seeds.
PRIOR_EVIDENCE_AND_ITS_STATUS.guard_sizing: ROUTED_COMPOSITION_STARTUP_GUARD_SIZING_READING.json -- DESCRIPTIVE PLANNING ESTIMATE ONLY, on the same 64 spent seeds that revealed the mechanism: A harm +0.172 -> 0, B gain +0.672 -> +0.625.
PRIOR_EVIDENCE_AND_ITS_STATUS.status_of_all_of_the_above: Planning and mechanism evidence, not confirmatory evidence. Sizing was optimistic by an unknown amount because the mechanism was found on those seeds. THE CONFIRMATORY RUN IS FREE TO DISAGREE WITH ALL OF IT, and any disagreement is reported as the result.

ARMS.STATE_GUARDED: the frozen V2 router plus the frozen full-window startup guard selects the composition per tick
ARMS.FIXED_2A2D: constant 2A/2D on both poles -- the A-safe baseline and the control for both primary gates
ARMS.FIXED_4A0D: constant 4A/0D on both poles -- descriptive reference only

FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT_UNCHANGED.state_machine_including_the_first_switch: unchanged; last_switch = -10000 is left exactly as frozen
FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT_UNCHANGED.no_retuning: byte-for-byte frozen. The executor reads these from the sealed V2 RESULT and aborts if its own constants disagree.

FROZEN_GUARD_UNCHANGED.rule: The selector may not depart from the default 2A/2D until its trailing buffer holds W samples. With W = 40 that first holds at 0-indexed tick 39.
FROZEN_GUARD_UNCHANGED.implementation_identity: The executor imports GuardedRouter from experiments/size_routed_startup_guard.py, the class that was sized. It is not re-implemented. A contract requires the confirmatory runner with the guard on to reproduce the sizing rows exactly on shared seeds.
FROZEN_GUARD_UNCHANGED.no_alternative_guard: No second guard length, no alternate minimum-window fraction, no threshold adjustment, before or after the result.

SEEDS_AND_DESIGN.why_n_is_128: Frozen by the PI. The sizing came from the same block that revealed the mechanism, so the design does not assume its zero-harm result reproduces. Planning arithmetic in ROUTED_COMPOSITION_STARTUP_GUARD_SIZING_READING.json shows 128 is where the useful gain in assurance for the A gate occurs when true late-trigger harm is small but nonzero, and that 192 buys little more. The gates below are unchanged; n is a design parameter frozen before any seed is spent.
SEEDS_AND_DESIGN.registry: Rule 9. The block was checked free and reserved under GUARDED_ROUTED_COMPOSITION_OUTCOME_V1 at freeze time, before any episode. The executor verifies ownership and does not allocate again. It sets SPENT after the run.
SEEDS_AND_DESIGN.pairing: Every one of the 128 seeds is run on both poles under all three arms: 128 x 2 x 3 = 768 episodes. Paired differences are taken within (pole, seed).
SEEDS_AND_DESIGN.poles: A = canonical attested parent; B = SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1. Identical pole construction, attestation and ruleset to the sealed oracle run and the routed outcome run.
SEEDS_AND_DESIGN.estimated_runtime: about 2.2 hours serial on one CPU process. Serial on purpose: the parity contracts are bit-exact and were established serially.

PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE_UNCHANGED.pairing: Per-seed paired differences in seed order, then bootstrapped over seeds. Win is the binary blue_win field.
PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE_UNCHANGED.A_may_not_be_required_to_improve: Pole A is a guardrail, not a second repair target.
PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE_UNCHANGED.known_property_of_the_A_gate_stated_in_a: The percentile bootstrap is lenient when discordant pairs are very few (an all-zero vector yields a zero-width interval). The gate is frozen as is. Its behaviour is stated here so it is not overread, and the run reports discordant-pair counts alongside the interval.

PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.GUARDED_ROUTED_COMPOSITION_CONFIRMED: B gate passes AND A gate passes. The guarded router improves Pole B without exceeding the frozen Pole-A harm tolerance, on fresh seeds.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.GUARDED_B_GAIN_WITH_EXCESS_A_HARM: B gate passes, A gate fails. The strategy still produces excess A harm. STOP this guard branch.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.GUARDED_A_PRESERVED_B_GAIN_LOST: A gate passes, B gate fails. The guard protects A but destroys the useful B effect. STOP.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.GUARD_INVARIANT_VIOLATED: Integrity outcome, takes precedence over all four labels above. If any STATE_GUARDED episode shows a first departure before tick 39, the guard did not hold and the run is invalid as a test of the guard. No confirmatory label is issued.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.label_names_note: The four outcome descriptions are the PI's; the label strings for the three non-confirming cases are assigned here so they are frozen before any seed is spent.
PREDECLARED_TERMINAL_INTERPRETATION.after_any_non_confirming_result: STOP the guard branch. No second guard length, no alternate minimum-window fraction, no threshold adjustment, no state-based veto, and no re-analysis of this block as a route to a different label.

DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_GATING.FIXED_4A0D: Reference only. No decision label depends on it.
reported: per-arm per-pole win rates and score margins
paired B gain and A harm with discordant-pair counts (harm flips, gain flips)
router telemetry on STATE_GUARDED per pole: tick fraction in 4A_0D, episodes with any trigger, switches per episode, first-onset distribution, blocked departures
B capture fraction and A damage avoided, with numerator and denominator intervals; a ratio is not reported when its denominator interval spans zero
DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_GATING.comparison_to_sizing: The sizing numbers (A harm 0, B gain +0.625) are reported next to the confirmatory numbers as a plain comparison. It is a comparison, not a test, and it changes no label.

CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C1_NO_REGIME_LEAK: The router interface takes exactly one scalar, d_value. Identical feature sequences give identical composition sequences.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C2_DEFAULT_IS_2A2D: 2A_2D at tick 0, and it stays there under above-trigger evidence.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C3_GUARD_HOLDS_AND_IS_INERT_AFTER_THE_WI: On strong-B fixtures and on all 32 held-out V2 traces, the guarded router never departs before tick 39. On any sequence whose UNGUARDED first departure is at or after tick 39, the guarded and unguarded composition sequences are identical throughout. Blocked departures occur only at ticks < 39.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C4_RELEASE_IS_NEVER_BLOCKED: After a departure at or after tick 39, high-D evidence releases to 2A_2D exactly as in the unguarded router.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C5_ARMS_DIFFER_ONLY_IN_COMPOSITION_SEQUE: (a) the guarded runner pinned to a constant composition reproduces the fixed runner field-by-field on both poles and both compositions; (b) the guarded runner with the guard DISABLED reproduces the sealed unguarded outcome rows on shared spent seeds; (c) the guarded runner with the guard ENABLED reproduces the sizing rows on the same seeds.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C6_CALIBRATION_PASS_SEALED: COMPOSITION_SELECTOR_TWO_FEATURE_UNCERTAINTY_AWARE_V2_RESULT.json has DECISION CONSERVATIVE_B_TRIGGER_CALIBRATED_V2 and this executor's constants equal its selected_config exactly.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C7_ONLINE_OFFLINE_EQUIVALENCE: With the guard disabled, the router reproduces the offline calibration state machine tick for tick on all 32 held-out V2 episodes.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C8_KNOWN_ANSWER_MEASUREMENT_PARITY: FIXED_2A2D re-run on spent oracle seeds 20100001-20100008, both poles, matches the sealed oracle rows exactly. Parity only: no new statistical evidence, no registry interaction, rows never mixed into the outcome rows.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C9_TERMINAL_SCORING_NOT_RESET_STATE: Scores read from info['episode_result'] at the instant done fires; the C8 subset must show a non-degenerate win rate.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C10_NO_PPO_REACHABLE: No PPO or trainer module is imported.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C11_OUTCOME_SEED_BLOCK_OWNED_AND_UNSPENT: 20300001-20300128 is registered to this experiment, RESERVED, exact range.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.C12_AUDIT_PLAN_SEALS_A_REGISTERED_BLOCK: The executor's real AuditPlan, run on synthetic rows of the exact shape against a registry in which the block is already reserved under this experiment, must pass all gating checks. A NEGATIVE CONTROL with the owner omitted must fail exactly the seed_class check, proving the dry-run can see the defect that caused AUDIT_FAILED on the previous run. This dry-run is executed AFTER the block is registered, not before.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE.on_failure: Seal CONTRACT_FAILURE and stop. No episode is run. A failing contract is diagnosed against its frozen reference before anything is edited; the router and the guard are never modified to satisfy a test.

SEALING.rule_7: The run must seal via experiments/run_state.py::seal with AuditPlan.experiment_id supplied. The payload may not set status. The audit re-derives both primary claims from the persisted rows CSV.
audited_claims: paired B difference STATE_GUARDED minus FIXED_2A2D on Pole B (mean, lcb95, ucb95)
paired A difference FIXED_2A2D minus STATE_GUARDED on Pole A (mean, lcb95, ucb95)

NOT_AUTHORIZED: any change to W, hysteresis, dwell, threshold, the statistic, the radii or the guard
a second guard length, an alternate minimum-window fraction, or a state-based veto
changing tau_A_harm, the gate definitions or n after any seed is spent
re-using 20200001-20200064, 20100001-20100064 or any smoke block as statistical evidence (C5/C8 parity only)
re-analysing the block to reach a different label
hand-writing a status string into the RESULT
claim_ceiling: Even GUARDED_ROUTED_COMPOSITION_CONFIRMED establishes only that a scripted two-feature router with a full-window startup guard improves Pole-B outcomes without exceeding the frozen Pole-A harm tolerance, under these two frozen opponents, at 4v4, PPO off, n=128 paired seeds. It does not authorize PPO, learned coordination or 6v6, and it does not generalize beyond these poles.
